headline: Ukrainian Drones Strike Russia's Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat Complex
summary: A massive Ukrainian drone strike struck Russia's Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat petrochemical complex in Bashkortostan, igniting a major blaze at one of the country's primary refining and chemical sites.
why: Attacks on Russian refining and petrochemical hubs disrupt domestic fuel supply and introduce volatility into global petroleum and energy markets.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Strikes on major Russian refining facilities threaten refined product supplies and lift energy prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
